comparison.objective: Scribe a shelf end to match a bowed wall.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a shelf while maintaining two-point compass contact along a continuous wall-following path.
comparison.success_condition: A continuous curved line matches the wall profile at measured stations, after which the compass and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Continuous surface following and profile transfer are different from fastener manipulation and closed-loop dynamic damper commissioning.
